description: Only the test file changes (the asserted values in test_add); src/lib.rs#add is byte-identical on both snapshots and must not appear as a changed symbol.

unchanged_symbols.note: add is byte-identical on both snapshots and must not be reported as added/removed/modified by anything in this fixture.

candidate_tests.rationale: test_add exercises add(...) only as an argument inside the assert_eq! macro; the call extractor does not record call references for arguments of macro invocations, so no call-path edge exists. See known_gaps.

known_gaps.description: A function call written as an argument to a macro invocation (assert_eq!(add(1, 2), 3)) produces zero call references for the callee: refs for add returns an empty refs array even though add is clearly invoked from the test.
